name: ripple
title: Ripple
description: A decorative set of thin concentric circles that continuously expand and fade from the middle, giving a soft radar-like pulse behind content.
use: A hero or feature panel wants a calm, radiating focal point behind it.
avoid: Light designs: the rings are so faint they barely register on pale backgrounds.
a11y: Decorative with no focusable parts; the endless expansion ignores prefers-reduced-motion. (keyboard: n-a, labels: n-a, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A black stage with a set of faint grey concentric rings centred in the middle, spaced closer together as they grow outward and fading with distance.
behaves: The rings slowly expand and fade in an endless loop, each offset slightly in time from the next so a ripple spreads outward from the centre.
customise: The base circle size, its opacity and the number of rings are props; ring spacing, growth and timing are fixed in the source.
weight: light: Eight plain divs animated by one CSS keyframe each; no script.
